title: Chicken Enchiladas
subtitle: Rolled tortillas baked in smoky tomato sauce
excerpt: Shredded poached chicken rolled in simple homemade flour tortillas, nestled in a smoky chipotle-style tomato sauce and baked with a cheddar crust. The tortillas take 10 minutes to make from scratch and taste far better than shop-bought. The whole dish can be assembled ahead and refrigerated before baking.
sourceNotes: Enchiladas trace back to Mayan traditions of rolling food in tortillas; the tomato-sauced baked version became embedded in Mexican-American cuisine through Tex-Mex cooking of the 19th and 20th centuries.

recipe.makeAheadNotes: Assemble the dish up to the point of baking, cover and refrigerate for up to 24 hours. Add 5 minutes to the bake time if going in cold.

content.text: Homemade flour tortillas need only flour, a pinch of salt, a drizzle of olive oil and water to come together. Work the dough until smooth, rest it for 10 minutes, then roll each portion as thin as you can on a lightly floured surface and cook for 60 seconds per side in a dry hot pan. They'll puff slightly and get a few dark spots, which is exactly right. If you prefer shop-bought tortillas, 8 medium corn or flour tortillas will work here.

for the tortillas; plus extra for rolling
1 tbsp for the tortilla dough, 2 tbsp for the sauce

content.text: Make the tortilla dough: mix the flour and a pinch of salt in a bowl. Add 1 tbsp olive oil and 80ml of warm water. Stir, then knead on a lightly floured surface for 2 minutes until smooth. Divide into 8 balls, cover with a damp cloth and rest for 10 minutes.

Heat the oven to 190C (fan 170C / Gas 5). Make the sauce: heat 2 tbsp olive oil in a frying pan over a medium heat. Fry the onion for 5 minutes until soft, then add the garlic, tomato puree, cumin, smoked paprika and chilli flakes. Cook for 1 minute, then pour in the tinned tomatoes. Simmer for 8 minutes until thickened. Season.

Cook the tortillas: heat a dry frying pan over a high heat. Roll each dough ball into a thin round, about 20cm across. Cook for 60 seconds per side until charred in spots. Stack under a tea towel to keep pliable.
Mix the shredded chicken with half the tomato sauce and the fresh coriander. Divide the filling between the tortillas, roll each one up tightly and arrange seam-side down in a baking dish.
Spoon the remaining sauce over the top and scatter with the grated cheddar. Bake for 20 to 25 minutes until the cheese is bubbling and golden. Serve with fresh coriander and lime wedges.

items.cause: Dough was not rested long enough or rolled too thin
items.fix: Rest the dough for another 5 minutes under a damp cloth. Roll gently and aim for 2mm rather than paper-thin.

items.cause: Chicken was overcooked during poaching or too little sauce was mixed in
items.fix: Add a splash of the reserved poaching water to the filling before rolling. Next time poach the chicken until just cooked through, about 15 minutes, and leave to cool in the liquid.
